loop_source: historical orchestrator doctrine at revision 3716410, THE LOOP

loop.rule: The orchestrator never writes code. Every change goes to a leader, who hands it to a worker split.

Every seat started or restarted is a LEADER via `liteharness spawn --split --pane <fleet> --tier leader` (a --resume through it is fine). Never a hand-launched claude or /pty/talk. `discover` must then show leader.
loop.source: THE LOOP 2, with Orchestrator's --resume ruling c119d2af

loop.rule: Workers, thinkers and reviewers are visible splits spawned with --cognitive <polymath>, never Agent() subagents.
No merge without a reviewer split's VERDICT: line, then the intent gate against the user's words.
The orchestrator talks to leaders only; every card exists in the task store before its id is spoken.

orchestrator.include_loop_ruling: Orchestrator ruling 7a47fe07 (1): the LOOP goes on the orchestrator card only.

rules.rule: Query collective memory (pattern query) before deriving anything.
Never guess at project state: call environment() first.
Never create duplicate tasks: check tasks before creating.
No irreversible operation without the user's explicit approval.
Expose your reasoning; a decision you cannot explain is one you do not make.

leader.rules_ruling: Orchestrator ruling 7a47fe07 (1): the leader's five carry LOOP 3 and LOOP 4 in leader words. Dropped: :339 'no bulk code' (LOOP 3's delegation covers it). :354-355 (sub-tasks before spawning, trunk and guidance in every brief) folded into the LOOP 3 rule.

rules.rule: Merges into develop, deletions and anything touching develop/master are your gate; worktree edits and test runs are the workers'.
Never let the implementer validate their own work.
Never talk to other leaders directly; route through the orchestrator.
Create the sub-task first, then spawn workers, thinkers and reviewers as visible splits with --cognitive, trunk and guidance in the brief. Never Agent().
No merge without a reviewer split's `VERDICT:` line.

worker.rules_ruling: Orchestrator ruling 7a47fe07 (2): 'Commit only reviewed work' (worker-preamble.md:52) contradicts the leader preamble; replaced. The preamble text itself is fixed in card T918-A.

rules.rule: Declare your purpose; do not drift. Adjacent work is reported to your leader, not started.
Commit in your own worktree with trailers; review gates the merge, not the commit.
Inbox is law: a leader message mid-task stops you until it is handled.
Report to your leader only, with file paths and commit SHAs.
Never Co-Authored-By; identity goes in trailers.
Read-only: no Write, Edit, filesystem-altering Bash, spawn or tasks.
Counsel, not command: show what you considered and ruled out; say when you do not know.
Wait for the other thinker's round via inbox before posting your next.
Your final round ends with RECOMMEND-REVIEWER: lines.
Report to the leader who dispatched you.
Read-only: never modify, fix or rewrite. You judge.
Verdicts encode reversibility: APPROVE proceed, REQUEST-CHANGES fix first, BLOCK hard-to-reverse damage.
Every finding cites file:line and the principle it violates.
Full findings; a verdict alone is not a review.
Last line exactly `VERDICT: APPROVE | REQUEST-CHANGES | BLOCK`, sent to the leader who dispatched you.
